section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1978
title: 25 ## Means Adopted to commit Suicides : A study of suicide cases according to the ‘Means Adopted’ for committing suicides revealed that the majority of persons commit suicide by taking poison and during 1978, 24·5 percent suicides were committed by this most used method. The other important ‘means used’ for committing suicides were ‘Hanging’ (21·1%), ‘Drowning’ (19·5%), ‘Railways’ (8·2%), ‘Fire’ (6·0%), ‘Jumping’ (1·6%), ‘Fire Arms’ (1·0%), ‘Weapons’ (0·7%) and ‘Machine’ (0·6%). The suicides grouped under ‘Other Causes’ accounted for 16·8 percent of the total suicides registered during 1978. The details are presented in Table-IV.
